title: Space saver
text: Space saver. This is a nice fan especially because it comes with a remote. I wish with the remotes like this that they would put a little hole in the corner somewhere so you can attach a handle or cord Because they can be easily lost . The fan itself works well And I would say The air Comes out about 7' From the fan Which is about the same as a round rotating fan. Extremely quiet which is good at night time

product_metadata.title: Tower Fan, Oscillating Tower Fan with Remote, 3 Modes, 3 Speeds, and 7-Hour Timer, Portable Space-Saving Bladeless Fan for Bedroom and Home Office 36”
features: 3-Mode and 3-Speed Tower Fan: Customize your cooling experience. Choose between normal, natural, and sleep modes and three different speeds

Quiet & Effective Cooling: The fan operates with very low noise for comfortable & peaceful sleep. It has a 6.6m/s Max airflow and wide 80° rotating coverage. There’s also a 7-hour timer for added convenience
Complete Control: Control the fan from the comfort of your sofa using the handy remote control, which has a 5m/16.4ft range
Compact Design: A slim & sleek fan with space-saving tower form that takes up minimal floorspace. An inner handle makes it easy to move. Get a cooling breeze wherever you need it
Reliable & Safe: Its solid performance and safety
